scope: First internal account-manager flow only; identities and resource metadata first, secret values never in this plan

execution.argv_policy: Execute each listed argv as a subprocess argument list after the two fixed launcher paths. No shell, interpolation, token argument, raw diagnostic output or automatic retries.
execution.output_policy: Capture stdout/stderr in memory. Persist only allowlisted resource name, existence, operation status and sanitized IAM bindings. No tokens/secret versions payloads or HTTP logging.
execution.read_before_write: Complete identity/resource inventory first. Reuse only resources whose type, identity and intended role match. Exact confirmed NOT_FOUND permits creation; permission/network/parse errors do not.
execution.unknown_mutation_result: Read the exact resource to reconcile before any repeated creation or grant.
execution.apply_policy: No bulk apply; run one numbered phase only when its gate has passed. This file itself executes nothing.

authorization_gate.needed_before_new_persistent_access: A concrete approval covering these four identities, their listed roles and private cloud transfer of three Hamle credentials.
authorization_gate.provenance: Prior explicit approval authorized hamle-probe-runtime and hamle-probe-build for synthetic data with no Gmail, Basecamp, OpenAI or customer-data access. Those accounts are not expanded here.
not_required_again: Existing 50 USD aggregate authorization through 2026-10-12 23:59:59 Europe/Istanbul
Completed 10 USD OpenAI funding and disabled auto-reload

funding_gate.warning: Do not charge prepaid token consumption against the shared limit twice. Resource creation/build/deploy costs need their own bounded reservation.

phases.name: Inventory only
phases.api_disabled_handling: An API_DISABLED result is not resource absence. Verify enabled APIs first; defer dependent describe until required API is explicitly enabled in phase 3. Never treat arbitrary command failure as NOT_FOUND.

phases.name: Create missing identities only; grant no roles yet
phases.gate: New persistent identity scope approved; all four names inventoried and no unexpected existing principal
phases.readback: Describe all four identities. Verify unique IDs, expected email/project, disabled=false and zero user-managed keys. Stop here if only identity creation was approved.

phases.name: Enable only missing APIs, then create missing resource metadata
phases.gate: Resource plan approved and fresh shared budget reservation recorded
phases.readback: Repeat exact-resource describes; verify region/type, private bucket settings and secrets with no version values. A second Firestore database must not be assumed free.

phases.name: Apply only approved runtime, control and build IAM
phases.gate: Every binding below approved and target resource exists; inspect current IAM before adding

conditional_basecamp_refresh_grant.only_if: Separate cloud rotating OAuth selected and its persistent refresh adapter accepted; not needed for PAT

phases.readback: Get IAM on project and each named secret/repository/bucket. Confirm no broad/unconditional database grant, no control/build secret access and no bindings added to probe accounts. Database condition is not collection-level security.

phases.name: Privately import credentials and build reviewed application
phases.gate: Approved cloud credential transfer, accepted adapters, known Basecamp credential method, reserved build budget
operations: Validate Gmail Keychain record in memory and submit by Secret Manager API. Store only version resource ID/checksum confirmation in evidence.
Provision separate cloud Basecamp credential through its approved method; never clone the Mac rotating OAuth login.
Read the existing authorized OpenAI key privately and submit by Secret Manager API; no new key merely for deployment.
Seed stopped control and import existing shared budget/prepayment/reservation history transactionally. Do not initialize an empty 50 USD balance.
Explicitly allowlist source files, scan build context for secrets, build once with hamle-build and pin immutable image digest.
phases.why_no_secret_command: A command embedding secret values or reading them to stdout is not a safe deployment recipe. Transfer helpers must be independently reviewable and quiet.

phases.name: Deploy stopped worker and authenticated control
phases.gate: Accepted worker/control entrypoints and signed IAP assertion validation; pinned image digest; stopped Firestore control
phases.status: No deploy command until the actual application entrypoint and image digest are verified; do not invent executable filenames
phases.readback: Verify IAP enabled, no allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers invocation, exact runtime identity, no secret environment values, fixed retry/timeouts and stopped control. Then perform explicit bounded read-only identity checks.

phases.name: Internal live acceptance before recurring scheduling
phases.gate: Real model call accepted, visible immutable internal proposal approved, funded budget and cloud control verified
acceptance: Exactly one approved response to Ahmet

Status/follow-up visible while local worker is off

phases.scheduler_activation_gate: Verified cloud-side expiry pause of both schedules before 2026-10-12T23:59:59+03:00; remaining provider/storage costs addressed; durable budget reconciliation ready
